# Web Security Scanner

> Free, passive website security scanner: 240+ automated checks covering SSL/TLS, HTTP security headers, DNS (SPF/DMARC/DNSSEC), vulnerabilities, JavaScript, API and CORS, SEO, Core Web Vitals, GDPR compliance, accessibility and dependencies. No registration, no payload sent to the scanned site, results in under 60 seconds. Bilingual: Serbian (sr) and English (en).

Operated by Toske-Programer. Source: https://github.com/UnlimitedEdition/security-scanner (MIT). Docs content: CC BY-NC 4.0.

Citation policy: this site allows search indexing and AI citation (Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes) and disallows AI model training (ai-train=no). Please cite pages by their canonical URL below.

## Security guides

- [CSRF Attacks](https://security-skener.gradovi.rs/blog-security-csrf): Detailed CSRF attack explanation: how they work, real examples (Gmail, Netflix), protection via tokens, SameSite cookies and framework defenses.
- [DNS Security](https://security-skener.gradovi.rs/blog-security-dns): Complete DNS security guide: SPF, DMARC, DNSSEC configuration, DNS attacks (cache poisoning, spoofing), email spoofing protection.

- [Website Malware Recovery](https://security-skener.gradovi.rs/blog-security-malware-recovery): Step-by-step guide to recovering a hacked website: quarantine, cleanup, blacklist removal, and hardening against reinfection.
- [Open Ports](https://security-skener.gradovi.rs/blog-security-ports): Which open ports pose a security risk: MySQL 3306, Redis 6379, MongoDB 27017. Nmap scanning, firewall rules, server protection.
- [SQL Injection](https://security-skener.gradovi.rs/blog-security-sql): Complete SQL Injection guide: how it works, types (Classic, Blind, Out-of-band), real examples (Equifax, Sony), protection with prepared statements, ORM and ...
- [SSL/TLS Certificates](https://security-skener.gradovi.rs/blog-security-ssl): Complete SSL/TLS certificate guide: how HTTPS encryption works, certificate types (DV, OV, EV), Let's Encrypt free certs, configuration and common errors.
- [XSS Attacks](https://security-skener.gradovi.rs/blog-security-xss): Complete guide to Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) attacks: types, real examples, consequences and detailed protection measures.

- [Lazy Loading](https://security-skener.gradovi.rs/blog-perf-lazy): Complete lazy loading guide: native loading=lazy, Intersection Observer, dynamic import, code splitting, fetchpriority, above/below fold rule.
- [Website Performance Guide](https://security-skener.gradovi.rs/blog-performance): Complete website performance guide: Core Web Vitals, image optimization, cache, compression, CDN, lazy loading. 6 detailed tutorials + 9 automated checks.
